provenance.dataset: CMS 2016 Open Data, SingleMuon Run2016G+H, NanoAODv9 (records 30530, 30563)
provenance.statement: real CMS 2016 Open Data events (SingleMuon Run2016G, NanoAODv9, record 30530), run/lumi/event listed; selected for display with seed 20260915 and the rules stated below; not a physics result
provenance.selection_sr: HLT_IsoMu24 || HLT_IsoTkMu24, MET filters, PV_npvsGood >= 1; exactly two tight muons, leading pT > 26, >= 1 trigger-matched, opposite sign, 60 < m(FSR-recovered) < 120 GeV (zmumu/regions.py:dimuon_regions)
provenance.selection_ss_tp: same-sign tag (tight, pT > 26, trigger-matched) + probe (tight or anti-isolated: tightId, 0.20 < iso < 1.0), bare pair mass > 12 GeV, both orientations of every muon pair (zmumu/fakes.py:85-101); pool restricted to barrel probes |eta| < 0.9, pT < 50 GeV
provenance.units: pT, mass, MET in GeV; dxy, dz in cm; angles in rad; floats rounded to 1e-5 (pT/mass) and 1e-6 (eta/phi/iso)

rules.textbook: 89 < m < 93 GeV, both |eta| < 0.9, back-to-back (|dphi| > 3.0), no FSR photon attached, no jet with pT > 30 GeV
rules.fsr: FSR-recovered mass exceeds the bare mass by more than 1 GeV (>= 1 attached FSR photon)

sr.masses_note: the first 500 SR masses in file order (for the rain)

ss_tp.chosen_rule: 9 anti-isolated probes (tightId, 0.20 < pfRelIso04 < 1.0, probe inside a jet preferred) + 1 isolated probe (tight): the display split reflects FF ~ 0.10 in the barrel cells (pT < 50, |eta| < 0.9: 0.093 / 0.103 / 0.087 / 0.118); unique events, seeded order with the isolated probe at a random position >= 1; the pool's raw n_tight/(n_tight+n_anti) is stored alongside
ss_tp.pool_note: pool = a seeded sample of barrel tight probes (<= 40) + barrel anti-isolated probes (<= 120 records in total)

checks.name: SR events re-select under the stored selection
SR mass == muons + attached FSR photons (1e-3 GeV)
20 SR events, 4 chosen with unique run/lumi/event
textbook: 89 < m < 93, |eta| < 0.9, |dphi| > 3.0, no FSR, no jet > 30
fsr: m - m_bare > 1 GeV with >= 1 photon
ten chosen: first is anti-isolated with the probe inside a jet
SS pairs: same sign, tag tight pT > 26 matched, m_bare > 12, probe class consistent, barrel FF cell correct, mass recomputed
